name: Harvard Study 2026
summary: Display ads promoting the Harvard CEPR study on phone-free schools and Yondr’s mention in it.
source: Source: Center for Education Policy Research, Harvard University, 2026
longHeadline: Harvard study: Using a Yondr pouch can add 1–2 extra weeks of learning a year.

headlines.desc: Harvard names Yondr’s phone-free program as a meaningful lever against learning loss.
Strict pouch programs can add 1–2 weeks of learning each year.
Results held across school levels, poverty levels and starting achievement.
Harvard researchers named phone storage a cost-effective way to add instruction time.
Fewer students tended to see large reading losses in schools using pouches.
